notablePrerequisites: You control four or more creatures.
description:
Activate Leafkin Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Leafkin Druid.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
